name: J.P. Morgan
seo_title: J.P. Morgan HireVue and Superday: what to expect
description: What J.P. Morgan's own careers pages say about applying, online tests and interviews, each line linked to its source.
intro: This guide sums up what J.P. Morgan's own careers pages say about applying and interviewing, from how to apply to how J.P. Morgan suggests you prepare. It reflects those pages as we checked them on 16 October 2026. Processes differ by programme, role and country, so check J.P. Morgan's careers site for your role before you apply.

items.text: J.P. Morgan says its hiring process has four steps: explore, apply, interview and decision.
J.P. Morgan's careers handbook says positions are filled on a rolling basis, so it recommends applying as soon as possible.
J.P. Morgan recommends applying to no more than three summer internship programmes each year.
For its 2027 Global Markets summer internship in London, J.P. Morgan recommends applying to only one Markets programme and asks applicants not to use a .edu or .ac.uk email address.
J.P. Morgan's careers handbook describes two rounds, the first being a recorded virtual interview on HireVue and/or HackerRank, with HackerRank for technology roles only.
J.P. Morgan says it will tell you if a role needs an assessment, and that the types it uses include structured live interviews, recorded interviews and virtual skills assessments.

J.P. Morgan says some roles use an on-demand recorded video interview, which shows you questions and lets you record your answers within a set timeframe; your device needs a camera and microphone, and it recommends professional business dress and a distraction-free setting.

For its 2027 Global Investment Banking summer internship in London, J.P. Morgan says applicants who move forward are emailed an invitation to a HireVue video interview, and the application is not reviewed further until it is done.

For its 2027 Global Markets summer internship in London, J.P. Morgan says applicants who move forward are invited to complete a HireVue video interview and a maths test, and the application is not reviewed further until both are done.
For its 2027 Corporate Analyst Development Program summer internship in London, J.P. Morgan strongly encourages applicants to complete the HireVue video within three days of receiving the invitation.
J.P. Morgan says the interview process differs for each position, and that you can expect to meet several people over more than one round.
J.P. Morgan's careers handbook says the interview round can include several interviews, held online and/or in person depending on the programme.

For its 2027 Commercial & Investment Banking Risk Management summer internship in London, J.P. Morgan says the HireVue video interview asks about your interest and motivation in the role, and successful applicants then go on to a Superday.
On its US Private Bank campus recruiting page, J.P. Morgan lists Superdays from January to April 2027 among its recruiting dates.

For its 2027 Spring Insights: Influence & Execute event in London, for students expecting to graduate in 2029, J.P. Morgan says participants practise commercial judgement and structured problem-solving through case-style exercises and group discussions.

J.P. Morgan says its Innovate for Impact Case Study Competition, for college sophomores studying in the US, has teams of four from the same university work on a hypothetical business challenge in a single round: the first half is virtual, followed by an invitation to present live, in person, to the firm's business representatives.

J.P. Morgan says its Asset & Wealth Management Challenge, for students in Asia, has teams of four complete a hypothetical case study over two rounds of written submissions and presentations, run separately in each location, with finalists from each location competing in the final round.
J.P. Morgan says it wants to hire the whole person rather than only a set of skills, and encourages candidates to be themselves in interviews.
For its Investment Banking Analyst internship, J.P. Morgan says candidates should show excellent analytical, quantitative and interpretative skills and be adaptable, flexible and resilient.

For its 2027 Global Investment Banking summer internship in London, J.P. Morgan says that beyond the listed requirements it is most interested in personal qualities, outside interests and achievements beyond academia.

sections.heading: How J.P. Morgan suggests you prepare

items.text: J.P. Morgan's careers handbook advises researching the firm, preparing two questions about the programme and being clear about why you chose the role.
The handbook suggests structuring examples from your own experience as context, action and result, or with the SHER model (situation, hurdle, endgame, reflection).
The handbook says not to use software to generate answers during an interview, unless you are invited to use an AI language model as part of the interview or exercise.
The handbook says to be ready to take notes during the interview, on paper or digitally, but not to read from notes or pre-written documents.

practice_advice: Practise explaining a client situation and your recommendation out loud in a few minutes, with the answer first and then your reasons.
Keep a short list of business stories you have followed, and practise saying what each one means for a company and its bank.
Do short, timed mental maths drills most days: the numbers in a case study are easier when the arithmetic is automatic.

practice.intro: Practise talking through a client situation and a recommendation out loud, with original bank-style case studies and an AI interviewer who plays a senior banker, then get a scored debrief with every number checked by code. These are our own practice cases, not a description of J.P. Morgan's process. Below: what J.P. Morgan itself publishes about its interviews, and the case studies we suggest.
